A grade table's record: what the run made, in one tracked row

Source: R/grade_record.R
knw_grade_record_write.Rd

A grade table (data/tune/<key>_grades.csv, written by scripts/0320) is one row per stream segment, 0.7 to 5.6 GB, and ignored. Every reader that checks which run made it reads only its first row, where the run's record sits in the constant columns. The record is that row's constant columns with the table's md5, size and row count, the run, the evidence ledger, the knowledge commit and link's build beside it, written once beside the table as <key>_grades_record.csv and tracked, so a machine without the table still knows which run it was and an article bundle pins the record rather than the table (#119). The archive (scripts/0336) stores the table and restores it against the record's md5.

Usage

knw_grade_record_write(
  grades_path,
  tune_run,
  evidence_ledger,
  knowledge_commit,
  link,
  tokens,
  rows = NA,
  record_source = c("0320", "backfill")
)

knw_grade_record_read(path)

knw_grade_record_check(record, grades_path)

Arguments

grades_path

character(1) the grade table.

tune_run

character(1) the tuning run that made it (0320's RUN), or the name a backfill gives a run that predates the record.

evidence_ledger

character(1) the evidence build ledger the run read.

knowledge_commit

character(1) the knowledge commit the run ran at, or NA where it is not known.

link

named character: version and sha of the link that built the network (the ledger's run_link_version and run_link_sha).

tokens

named character c(cut =, acc =, grad =, flow =) from knw_build_record(); NA where the build predates link's vocabulary.

rows

numeric(1) the table's row count, or NA: counting a 5 GB table to write its record costs more than the record is worth, so the writer passes what it knows and the check never reads it.

record_source

character(1) "0320" (written with the table) or "backfill" (written later from a table that predates the record).

path

character(1) a <key>_grades_record.csv.

record

a record from knw_grade_record_read().

Value

knw_grade_record_write(): the record (a one-row data frame), invisibly, after writing it beside the table. knw_grade_record_read(): the record. knw_grade_record_check(): TRUE, invisibly, or an error naming what differs.

Examples

d <- tempfile(); dir.create(d)
g <- file.path(d, "CH_rear_grades.csv")
utils::write.csv(data.frame(id_segment = 1:2, grade = c(0.1, 0.2), species_code = "CH", stage = "rear",
                            rule = "r1", run_uid = "u1", ref_population = "stream_branch", ref_edge = "1000",
                            q_walk = 0.75, walk = "bank", walk_md5 = "w", discharge_load = "wet load",
                            curve_prior_sd = 1, grade_withheld = FALSE, null_heldout_curve = 1.5,
                            evidence_md5 = "a;b;c", curve_grad = "segment_gradient"),
                 g, row.names = FALSE)
knw_grade_record_write(g, tune_run = "20261027_0000", evidence_ledger = "ledger.csv",
                       knowledge_commit = NA, link = c(version = "0.66.0", sha = "abc"),
                       tokens = c(cut = NA, acc = NA, grad = NA, flow = NA), rows = 2)
r <- knw_grade_record_read(file.path(d, "CH_rear_grades_record.csv"))
r$rule
#> [1] "r1"
knw_grade_record_check(r, g)
